'''New Republic''' is a Light Side [[Character]] type of the [[Virtual Legacy]] cards, shown by the New Republic icon (the Rebel starbird inside a ring of stars) in the top left corner of the card. The [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]] defines it as “a type of Light Side character, representing individuals that are directly involved with the New Republic.”<ref name="ar20-nr">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0#Chapter 9 - The Cards - Attributes, Types & Icons|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Chapter 9, entry “Characters – New Republic”, p. 9-4 ([[:File:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]], PDF page 70; [https://web.archive.org/web/20150807023558/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf#page=70 Internet Archive copy]).</ref> It is not the same as [[Republic]] or [[Rebel]]: the rulebook notes that “the "Republic" and "New Republic" icons represent two completely separate government entities and are not interchangeable in any way.”<ref name="ar20-rep">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0#Chapter 9 - The Cards - Attributes, Types & Icons|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Chapter 9, entry “Characters - Republic”, p. 9-4 ([[:File:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]], PDF page 70).</ref>

The type is not in the Decipher rules ([[Decipher Comprehensive Rules]], [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]]) or in the current [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]]; it belongs to the pre-2014 Virtual Legacy cards, now played in [[Legacy Open]].

Examples: [[Anakin Solo]] ([[Virtual Block 8]]), [[General Bel Iblis]] and [[Jaina Solo]] ([[Virtual Block 9]]).
